title: Popa: From Sourcing to Distribution
content: An Android proxyware SDK named Popa enrolls consumer devices including phones, tablets, and streaming boxes into a commercial residential proxy network. Operating since at least 2020, Popa and its variants (Loopop, Neupop, and Moneytiser) are distributed inside consumer streaming, IPTV, and utility applications. title: Klue Integration Abused in Salesforce Data Theft | Threat Spotlight

title: Botnet Analysis: A Product-Grade Threat for the AI Service Era

title: Contagious Interview malware in SVG images: DPRK campaign
content: A DPRK-aligned threat group is targeting developers through fake job postings and coding challenges in a campaign tracked as REF9403. Attackers post fake job offers in developer forums, then send trojanized repositories containing fully functional e-commerce projects with malicious code hidden using steganography inside SVG flag images.
